subject: Jades
text: The jades must be set into the towers in the specific order of Blue, Green, then Red to warp to Elfrea.

evidence.quote: Now, you have to head back to every tower and set the jades in, making sure you do it in the order of Blue, Green, Red. *GROAN*. Refer back to my guides to those towers if you forget your way through. Use your large collection of Sweet Waters to keep the monsters away if you're sick of random battles, even though they hardly ever do a good job of it. After you put the red jade on, you're automatically warped to Elfrea, and my least favorite part of the game is finally over!

subject: Artea's house
text: Potions can be found inside Artea's house in Elfrea.

evidence.quote: Take the potions in Artea's house and then talk to him upstairs.

subject: Artea
text: Speaking to Artea upstairs yields the Shrine Key and an improved weapon for Jerin.

evidence.quote: He tells you tons of information about your journey, and then gives you the Shrine Key and a better weapon for Jerin.

subject: Magic Wall
text: From the hallway between the front room and the stone room, navigate the Magic Wall puzzle by moving Up-1, Right-2, Up-1, Right-2, Up-4, Left-3, Down-1, Left-2, Down-1, Left-2, Up-2, Right-1, Up-1, Right-2, then heading straight up the steps.

evidence.quote: From the small hallway from the front room to the room with the four stones, go: Up-1, Right-2, Up-1, Right-2, Up-4, Left-3, Down-1, Left-2, Down-1, Left-2, Up-2, Right-1, Up-1, Right-2, and then head straight up the steps.

subject: Odel Castle flowers
text: The flowers on the right side of the castle contain Great, Speed, and Mind Potions.

evidence.quote: Head to the right side and take the Great, Speed, and Mind Potions from the flowers.

subject: Odel Castle first floor cabinets
text: The first floor of Odel Castle contains Power and Spell Potions, as well as two Hi Magics inside cabinets.

evidence.quote: On the first floor, take the Power and Spell Potions, and then the two Hi Magics from the cabinents.

subject: Lyden area enemies
text: Enemies encountered around Lyden yield approximately 700 to 800 EXP per battle.

evidence.quote: For some reason, all the enemies around Lyden give around 700-800 EXP per battle, which is amazing.

subject: Shaia Lab 2 cabinets
text: Cabinets located down the upper right steps of the castle courtyard in Shaia Lab 2 contain a Mind Gourd and a Power Gourd.

evidence.quote: Before you leave, head down in the castle courtyard and down the upper right steps. You'll be in Shaia Lab 2. What's Shaia Lab? We'll get to that later. In the cabinents you can find a Mind and Power Gourd.

subject: Ice Snake
text: Ice Snakes found in Odel Cave possess only 100 HP.

evidence.quote: The enemies are cheese, too, especially the Ice Snakes, which only have 100 HP.

subject: Mimicker
text: Mimickers in Odel Cave award roughly 2500 EXP points per battle.

evidence.quote: The Mimickers in here  give about 2500 EXP points per battle, though!

subject: Broken bridge area
text: A Dragon Egg and an Ex Potion can be collected near the broken bridge inside Odel Cave.

evidence.quote: Inspect the broken bridge, and then take the Dragon Egg and Ex Potion and leave.

subject: Piron
text: Talking to Piron and his assistant and viewing the bridge from the other side prompts them to build the bridge across the chasm.

evidence.quote: After that's done with, enter the fourth entrance and go to the bridge. Talk to both Piron and his assistant, to find out you have to go back all the way around and look over the bridge. Go there, and then watch them build the bridge.

subject: North cave entrance
text: Inside the north entrance of Odel Cave, a Half Mail, Glass Robe, Stone Cure, Quilted Silk, and Miracle can be found.

evidence.quote: Go to the far north entrance and enter. Go down and take the Half Mail, then around for the Glass Robe. The Stone Cure is to the left, and the Quilted Silk and Miracle are far down in the left corner.

subject: Second cave entrance
text: A Glass Cap lies far southwest from the second entrance of Odel Cave, with an Iron Helm and Wind Shoes located even farther in that direction.

evidence.quote: There is a Glass Cap far southwest from the 2nd entrance, and an Iron Helm and Wind Shoes even farther than that.

subject: Bridge north side
text: Heading right, up, and around on the north side of the bridge allows you to collect an Escape and Hi Arrows.

evidence.quote: On the north side, go right, up, and around to claim an Escape and Hi Arrows.

subject: Lower level muck
text: A Miracle is located across the muck in the lower level of Odel Cave.

evidence.quote: Now head back down the right passage and into a lower level. Trudge across the muck and grab the Miracle, then continue on.

subject: Ground floor exits
text: Returning to the ground floor reveals a Revive, an Ex Potion down to the far left, and a second Revive after ascending the next ladder.

evidence.quote: After Lufia does her crazy spell thing and you make it through the basement level, you should be back on the ground floor. Take the Revive. Now go all the way left and down to get an Ex Potion. Take another Revive after climbing the next ladder.

subject: Arus northern house flower
text: The flower in the top right-hand corner of the large northern house in Arus contains a Mind Potion.

evidence.quote: At the large house up north, the flower in the top right-hand corner contains a Mind Potion.

subject: Old Cave 6th floor room
text: Three Hi Bombs can be picked up while ascending the 6th floor of the Old Cave, and entering the first room yields the Gladius along with three potions.

evidence.quote: On the 6th floor of the Old Cave, take the 3 Hi Bombs as you go up, and enter the first room. In the room, you'll find the Gladius, a new sword for Hero. AND IT'S NOT CURSED! You'll find some more new equipment in this room as well as  3 potions.

subject: Old Cave 6th floor muck
text: An Ex Magic and Ex Potion are found in the muck, and two spaces up on the right from the right chest lies a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Take the Ex Magic and Ex Potion in the muck, but that isn't all that's there. From the right chest, two spaces up on the right is a Miracle.

subject: Old Cave 6th floor left room
text: The Hammer Rod for Lufia is found on the left side of the floor.

evidence.quote: On the left, you'll find the critically-acclaimed HAMMER ROD, which is a stronger rod for Lufia sporting a stylish hammer on the end!

subject: Old Cave downstairs
text: Downstairs in the Old Cave, you can obtain an Ex Magic, Power Gourd, Ex Potion, Knife Shoes, and Needle Shoes.

evidence.quote: Downstairs, get the Ex Magic, Power Gourd, Ex Potion, as well as the brilliant Knife and Needle Shoes.

subject: Old Cave final chest set
text: A Mind Gourd, Blast Ring, and Miracle Gem can be retrieved from the final treasure set, along with a Miracle hidden in the muck three steps below the Blast Ring.

evidence.quote: Back on ground floor, take the Mind Gourd and proceed to the last set of treasures. Take the Blast Ring and Miracle Gem, and don't forget to get the Miracle, which is in the muck three steps below the Blast Ring.

subject: Tower of Grief entrance rooms
text: The right path of the Tower of Grief holds a Purple Ring, while going up the stairs in the center room grants a Dragon Egg, Revive, and Stone Cure.

evidence.quote: Collect the Purple Ring from the right path, then enter the center room and go up the steps to recieve a Dragon Egg, Revive, and Stone Cure.

subject: Tower of Grief third floor stairways
text: Ascending the southwest stairways on the third floor leads to an Ex Potion and Hi Magic, whereas the northeast stairway yields a Revive and Stone Cure.

evidence.quote: On the third floor, you'll be greeted with not one, not two, not three, but FOUR stairways. Go up the southwest stairways to get an Ex Potion and Hi Magic, and then the northeast for another Revive and Stone Cure.

subject: Tower of Grief refiller
text: A full HP and MP restoration point is available on the fifth floor of the Tower of Grief.

evidence.quote: On the fifth floor, you get a HP/MP refiller, which, you don't really need since the enemies here are weak.

subject: Tower of Grief top floor
text: The chest on the top floor of the Tower of Grief contains a Miracle.

evidence.quote: On the top floor you'll see an old man and a treasure chest. Hmmm. . .stylish old man. . .treasure. . .stylish old man. . .treasure. . .TREASURE! Take the treasure for a Miracle.

subject: Platina cabinets
text: Four cabinets at the top of the right stairs in Platina contain a Hi Magic, Ex Arrows, Gloom Arrow, and Hi Bomb.

evidence.quote: Go up the right stairs, and check the four unusual cabinents to get a Hi Magic, Ex Arrows, Gloom Arrow, and Hi Bomb.

subject: Professor Raile
text: Raile tests the Falcon in the basement of Platina, leaving the party with a ship capable of exploring the surface sea.

evidence.quote: He'll take you to the basement and try out the Falcon, but in the end all he leaves you with is a leaky ship that can't travel underwater. Ah well. At least you can explore the sea.

subject: Forfeit second floor shop
text: Customers are forced to purchase an item to leave the shop with the purple-and-green checked floor on the second floor of Forfeit, with the cheapest items priced at 2 and 5 Gold.

evidence.quote: Be warned about the shop on the 2nd floor with the purple-and-green checked floor, because the girls in there will FORCE you to buy something to leave! Luckilly, there are items there that are 2 and 5 Gold each.

subject: Secret stairwell shop
text: Entering the secret stairwell behind the building in Forfeit leads south to the back of the item shop to obtain a Mind Ring.

evidence.quote: Go around the building and enter the secret stairwell behind the place. South leads to the back of the item shop's place, giving you a Mind Ring.

subject: Carbis island
text: A Mind Potion can be acquired upon reaching Carbis on Shaia Lab 3.

evidence.quote: Warp back to Platina and head west to the small island that Carbis, or Shaia Lab 3, is on. Grab the Mind Potion and then go down to the basement.

subject: Cooper
text: Cooper is trapped in the room where the Gold Pawn was previously found in the Old Cave after his escape fails.

evidence.quote: When you talk to the priest, you'll find that Cooper is at the Old Cave. Great. More chasing. I guess this is to force people who aren't even at Level 20 to get there. Just follow it to the last room where you took the Gold Pawn before. Cooper will be in there waiting. After his escape craps out and you save his sorry behind, you can head back to Carbis.

subject: Falcon repair
text: Repairing the hole in the Falcon requires collecting seven pieces of Allumina.

evidence.quote: Once Cooper is back with Raile, you'll find out that you need seven pieces of Allumina to fix the hole in the Falcon.
